en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a European city with a river in the foreground, a bridge crossing it, tree‑lined embankments, and historic buildings on the right bank. A church tower with a bulbous Baroque dome rises above the rooftops. Behind the town stands a steep hill crowned with fortifications and another notable tower on the slope. The scene is framed by mountains in the distance. Handwritten text at the bottom reads "Graz, Schlossberg."
